items.text: just test baseline ~3m42s: Homebrew ~89s, uncached mise ~41s, apt update ~26s, gopls recompile ~15s.
From linked worktrees, test fails at 'dotfiles : Clone TPM' with 'fatal: not a git repository'; only .:/dotfiles mounted.
Cached local just test must finish under 45 seconds, target ~25s–35s.
Fix gopls check in roles/dotfiles/tasks/nvim.yml to test real binary (which gopls), not nonexistent creates path.
Add cache_valid_time: 86400 to apt task in roles/dotfiles/tasks/prereqs.yml.
Mount persistent .ci-cache/ volumes in docker-compose.yml for mise runtimes/cache, tmux plugins, go/coc.
Default DOTFILES_ANSIBLE_EXTRA_ARGS to "--skip-tags brew,rust" in docker-compose.yml, matching ubuntu-tests.yml.
just test-unit runs ansible-playbook --syntax-check covering all task files, including skipped brew.yml/rust.yml.
New justfile recipe just test-clean wipes .ci-cache/ and runs full cold test without --skip-tags.
justfile resolves git common dir and bind-mounts it read-only for test, test-clean, dev recipes.
Configure git safe.directory "*" in container via both docker-compose.yml and Dockerfile.
Don't rewrite Docker base image to bake in user runtimes.
No remote CI workflow changes beyond flag alignment; no changes to macOS dotfiles install logic.
All 54 Goss and 25 Bats tests pass in just test, from primary checkout and .worktrees/ worktree.
